summary.text: Dewith Carrier is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 32, representing Allen, Beauregard, Calcasieu, and Jefferson Davis, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2019 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Dewith Carrier's occupation as Self-Employed.
It lists Dewith Carrier's education as McNeese State University.
The House member page lists Dewith Carrier's committee assignments as Appropriations; Natural Resources and Environment; Retirement; Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
